cohort: The cohort consisted of 9,922,142 pregnant women from the National Readmission Database, of whom 3,532 (0.04%) had pulmonary hypertension.
finding: Pregnant women with pulmonary hypertension had significantly higher rates of adverse events, including an 85-fold increased risk of in-hospital maternal mortality, compared with those without PH.
country: United States (inferred from National Readmission Database and 'nationwide')
followup_time: Up to 30 days post-discharge for readmissions; short-term for other maternal and fetal outcomes (likely during hospitalization or peripartum period)
